syntheses.title: Advancement from Early End-to-End Models to Modern CNN-Based Autonomous Driving Systems
syntheses.body: Early autonomous driving systems like ALVINN demonstrated the feasibility of end-to-end neural network steering using relatively small fully-connected networks and limited data (claims 443f6210-6468-59f8-8167-b719d39fc8fd, 64fadfcd-be98-5c13-b01c-6d0c033e603e). Modern approaches leverage convolutional neural networks (CNNs) with greater computational power and more extensive data, enabling the learning of the entire processing pipeline for steering (claims e66d15a0-9347-5814-b053-1ff1dea8058d, f78de3ab-0095-5d09-a3ae-9f15b81a03b6). This progression reflects significant improvements in model capacity and data utilization, leading to more robust and vehicle-independent steering control (claim 34d85362-1ab7-5462-ac7c-f2c84434250b).

syntheses.title: Mid-Level Representations and Recurrent Architectures Enhance Autonomous Driving Model Training and Simulation
syntheses.body: ChauffeurNet employs a recurrent neural network (RNN) architecture that processes mid-level input representations to output driving trajectories, integrating components like FeatureNet and AgentRNN with co-trained perception modules (claims cc49c2d4-b50d-5322-8525-304268249b24, a074e01e-adb6-51f9-a4d9-c118eae03923, 895eafbb-3f11-5339-9345-8de95a48f4d0). Mid-level representations facilitate training on both real and simulated data and enable closed-loop simulation testing prior to real-world deployment (claims 5fc32090-a96e-5352-b867-05795d95ae56, e4571968-f7ab-5ab9-9db6-21554bbefe13). This approach supports iterative prediction refinement through recurrent feedback mechanisms (claims 2eb1abf8-84f5-5074-a80b-6452e5ee9f11, 28ac3012-c446-509b-bbe5-067fc5348a93).

syntheses.title: CARLA Simulator as a Comprehensive Platform for Autonomous Urban Driving Research
syntheses.body: CARLA is an open-source urban driving simulator providing extensive digital assets including urban layouts, vehicles, buildings, pedestrians, and street signs, created by a dedicated team of digital artists (claims 6dde98eb-ff12-5785-926e-11fbb8cd299b, 0488bcfc-4a7e-5848-a1d4-1e81239f8f55, 35654313-1c19-5ea8-90b3-6083cb8bfe35, eaa96757-17f0-557c-9c27-40cae0a06932). It supports flexible sensor suite specification, environmental condition control, and provides exact measurements of agent state and traffic rule compliance (claims b26241aa-3d3d-560b-9a47-d8c65f50bfa3, 2ef71665-a8a3-556d-864e-59cd9b75ce1c, f9f4ac99-3040-540e-a263-7730701fb5d1, a4766e4b-52af-520a-b0f2-2c0267bf443f). CARLA enables development, training, prototyping, and validation of autonomous driving models including perception and control, and is used to evaluate classic modular pipelines, end-to-end imitation learning, and reinforcement learning approaches (claims 2dedfe39-6dab-5024-be2e-997515e0211d, 95c1e45a-f076-5974-87ce-1ddf31a356f5, 34863bb0-827c-5405-a15d-f7229ca8985c, 7e8db57a-25dd-55f8-9220-c289a62aea7f).

syntheses.title: Limitations of Pure Imitation Learning in Autonomous Driving Despite Large Datasets and Mid-Level Representations
syntheses.body: Studies show that pure imitation learning approaches, even when trained with large datasets (e.g., 30 million examples) and mid-level input/output representations, face significant challenges such as error accumulation and distribution shift during closed-loop operation (claims 639f88c8-001d-587a-bae9-390fb3c89dcf, c9759883-dd81-58a9-ab2d-155a512245df, 09081b52-e1ad-5843-9bbc-8565cf5aea59). These limitations manifest in practical issues like the model getting stuck or colliding with parked vehicles despite viable passing options (claim cf5a09ec-bfde-5049-ac07-ec7d2e843d78). This evidence highlights the need for approaches beyond pure imitation learning to achieve reliable autonomous driving.
